title: Players Found a Literal Easter Egg on Top of GTA 6's Tallest Tower 🥚 #Shorts
description:
A real egg, in a bird's nest, at the top of GTA 6's tallest radio tower. Kotaku reports the climb takes about six minutes and one of its writers found the egg in the nest. Players report that throwing it off the tower triggers a short cutscene where it hits a car's windshield (player reports; Rockstar has not commented).

Source: Kotaku – GTA 6 launch live updates (Nov 18-19, 2026).
Images: official Rockstar Games trailers.
Fan channel, not affiliated with Rockstar Games.
